mechanism_narrative: The Federal Funds Rate at or below 0.1% compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive 20-day forward returns for the S&P 500.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%, the S&P 500 produces negative or flat 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market deterioration indicated by UNRATE above 5.5% signals economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings potential, producing negative 20-day forward returns for the S&P 500.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A dual labor market stress (PAYEMS yoy change < 0 and UNRATE > 5.5%) signals severe economic weakness, producing negative 20-day forward returns for the S&P 500.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS yoy change < 0 AND UNRATE > 5.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In the regime of low interest rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 250), the combination erodes real returns and increases uncertainty, producing negative 60-day forward returns for the S&P 500.
regime_hint: low interest rate and high inflation regime
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS <= 0.1% AND CPIAUCSL > 250, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500, it signals potential economic slowdown prompting monetary policy easing, boosting equity valuations and producing positive 5-day forward returns for the S&P 500.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1500, the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals severe economic contraction and reduced corporate profitability, producing negative 60-day forward returns for the S&P 500.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 and housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500, the dual decline signals severe economic contraction, producing negative 20-day forward returns for the S&P 500.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100 AND HOUST < 1500, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When Residential Sales (RSAFS) exceed 500000, it indicates a robust economy and increased consumer confidence, supporting equity valuations and producing positive 20-day forward returns for the S&P 500.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 500000, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances.
